from_quote: One branch of the new government is to be appointed by these legislatures
rationale: Says one branch of the new government "is to be appointed by these legislatures" of the States, the mode of choosing Senators set in this clause.

from_quote: they have reported a plan which is to be confirmed by the PEOPLE, and may be carried into effect by NINE STATES ONLY
rationale: Says the plan "may be carried into effect by NINE STATES ONLY," naming the number of ratifying States set in this article.
to_quote: The Ratification of the Conventions of nine States, shall be sufficient
